name: playwright-saucedemo
description: Playwright POM Framework with Allure Reporting

scripts.smoke:ci: npm run clean:allure && npm run smoke && npm run allure:smoke
scripts.regression:ci: npm run clean:allure && npm run regression && npm run allure:regression
scripts.test:cart:allure: rimraf allure-results allure-report && npx playwright test tests/cart.spec.ts --headed && allure serve allure-results
scripts.test:addToCart:allure: rimraf allure-results allure-report && npx playwright test tests/addToCart.spec.ts --headed && allure serve allure-results

author: Kashyap Dave
